name: cable-face-pull-with-external-rotation
instructions:
1. Assume a split stance with the arms straight out in front of you utilizing a neutral grip (palms facing).
2. Inhale and pull the rope towards your face with the elbows high.
3. As the end of the rope approaches your face, pull the ends apart and drive the elbows back.
4. Slowly lower the rope back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions on both sides.
